newsitem.title: LIBYA: OAU invites Zaire to the African summit in Togo.
newsitem.headline: OAU invites Zaire to the African summit in Togo.

text.p: African foreign ministers have invited turbulent Zaire to attend a summit next month in Togo to discuss the situation in the Great Lakes region.
"All the states in the Central Africa region were invited to Togo summit," Ibrahim Daggash, a spokesman for the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) told reporters. He did not elaborate.
Zairean Foreign Minister Kamanda Wa Kamanda said: "The OAU decision means that Zaire is invited to the Togo meeting."

The ministers, meeting in Tripoli for an annual conference, on Wednesday scheduled the summit for March 18 and 19 to discuss the situation in the Great Lakes region and especially Zaire where rebels are fighting government forces.

The rebels have overrun a 1,000 km (600-mile) stretch of Zaire since they took up arms in October against ailing President Sese Seko Mobutu, a veteran leader they call a despot and have vowed to topple.
The summit was called at the request of Togo, Benin and Nigeria.
